prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup.
Create a replacement smartphone hardware sprite for the simple code-drawn phone in reference image 1. Reference 1 is the current game shot, reference 2 is the surrounding illustrated environment for lighting compatibility ONLY. Output ONLY the isolated improved device, not the screenshots, scene, UI, or a comparison.
One contemporary unbranded graphite-black smartphone seen EXACTLY from the front, perfectly upright, zero in-plane rotation, parallel vertical edges, orthographic projection so dynamic UI can be composited onto its screen in code. Realistic physical proportions: phone body width:height approximately 9:19.5, subtly rounded corners, very thin equal bezels, precision-milled dark metal frame, gentle polished chamfer catching a soft silver cool light on one side and a muted neutral warm reflection on the other. Tiny authentic receiver grille at the uppermost edge; a small centered circular front camera near top of screen, with restrained glass lens detail. Fine antenna breaks in the metal. Separate believable volume and power buttons just barely protruding. The front face should be almost flush; only a very thin side edge, NOT a three-quarter view.
High quality detailed product illustration with physically credible metal and glass, carefully lit without looking like a flat vector outline, but smooth restrained finish that sits naturally over an anime game background. No excessive shine, no thick luminous border.
Screen must be powered off and completely blank dark charcoal #090d12, NO text, NO icons, NO keyboard, NO home bar, NO branding, NO logo. Keep the large center of the screen neutral and uncluttered for overlaid animated text. Very subtle restrained glass reflections at the outer edges only, no diagonal bright band across the screen.
CRITICAL: genuine transparent alpha PNG outside the phone; do not paint a checkerboard, do not include a backdrop, no ground, no cast shadow outside the device, no hands, no cable. Entire phone fully visible, centered in a tall portrait canvas at least 1024x2048, slim transparent margin around every side. Exactly one device.
